title: Certify no gain in a joint productive-helper/native fusion family
body:
This supplies an exact no-gain certificate for a source-derived family of **2^1079 joint helper/contact chart choices**, including minimization over all **72 compatible shared late native maps**, throughout **0 <= C <= 0.005**. Every paid transition, changed physical native rank and whole helper reward is counted; all 408 helpers remain productive. The minimum paid-minus-helper change is identically zero. **No new kappa or physical supplier is claimed.**

The source is Cao Yifan's round-three word on main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Applying #4692's commuting equal-ADD rule removes 98 scalar events per orientation before frame optimization. A standalone checker independently verifies each commutation and reconstructs the complete dual words. The new contribution is the changed-word, joint-helper, all-C symbolic flow certificate; it does not claim priority for ADD combination, graph cuts, or #5144's shared-map rank formula.

The independent checker rebuilds the chronological graph, all four-state rank tables, and the cut energy, then checks a feasible symbolic flow and a matching cut using a separate rational interval implementation. Fifty helper entrances and forty exits vary. All other native occurrences retain their actual zero/full or twelve shared line constraints. The result excludes this explicit binary family, not arbitrary subspaces, scalar programs, Clifford charts or changed prelude interfaces.

Validation at `33ec006ab679bf0b408965cc9dd39fc127061ca5`:

- Registered normal and optimized Python replays pass; standard library only.
- Independent agent reviews and thirteen corruption controls pass, including a forged negative circulation that preserves conservation and cut equality.
- Exact source/history and committed-byte checks, official export integrity, optimized Git-free export replay, and whitespace checks pass. Hosted CI has not yet run.

One new research package; no shared tooling, predecessor evidence or selected record changes. Credit Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, Dugongue, Matarener, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, the retained native lineage, and the cited graph-cut/fusion literature. Prepared for flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and independent AI agents; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Apache-2.0.
